# TerrariaModder

> A lightweight Windows modding framework for Terraria 1.4.5.8.

TerrariaModder loads .NET Framework 4.8 mods into the normal Steam Terraria process through TerrariaInjector. It provides Harmony patching, typed configuration, keybinds, UI widgets, lifecycle callbacks, custom items, save sidecars, networking, and server administration. Terraria.exe remains the vanilla launch path; TerrariaInjector.exe is the modded launch path.

## Released mods

| Mod | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Skip Intro | Waits for Terraria startup loading, then skips the splash |
| Quick Keys | Torch, recall, quick stack, ruler, and optional inventory slots 11-20 |
| Item Spawner | Search and spawn vanilla or registered modded items |
| Auto Furniture Buffs | Applies buffs from nearby furniture, including the Dead Cells station |
| Pet Chests | Uses cosmetic vanity pets as portable piggy banks |
| Storage Hub | Registered storage, transactional crafting, shimmer, progression, relays, and Mysterious Chest |
| Admin Panel | God mode, movement, time, teleport, respawn, and NPC controls |
| Whip Stacking | Enables Terraria's native maximum of five simultaneous whip tag effects |
| Seed Lab | Mixes secret-seed world-generation and singleplayer runtime features |
| FPS Unlocked | Renders above 60 FPS while game simulation stays at 60 Hz |
| Biome Spread Control | Prevents corruption, crimson, and Hallow spread in singleplayer |
| Randomizer | Deterministic modules for loot, drops, recipes, shops, spawns, and more |
| Debug Tools | Optional in-game console, localhost HTTP API, virtual input, inspection, and window controls |

## Mod author notes

- Core uses manifest.json as authoritative mod metadata.
- New mods can inherit ModBase and implement IModLifecycle.
- Direct Terraria/XNA references are supported for accessible APIs.
- Reflection remains useful for inaccessible members and client/server assembly boundaries.
- Config properties use Client or Server scope and can declare Range, Options, OptionProvider, RestartRequired, and migration metadata.
- Each process writes a separate session log under TerrariaModder/core/logs/.
- Source: https://github.com/Inidar1/terraria-modder
- Downloads: https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Inidar/mods
